title: / V ZIVO IZ STUKA - STUK-OV STUDENTSKI TOREK

lines.l: I know I should sleep, but the voices in my head go
When I came to Spain and asked if it's for me
I thought to myself, what the fuck
Viva la fiesta, viva la noche
Viva los biches, what the fuck
I couldn't believe what I was living, so I called my friend Johnny and I said to him,
And Johnny can I say to him?
Johnny, la gente esta muy loca
Johnny, la gente esta muy loca
